VERIFICATION FAILED for PAN-4638 (attempt 1/3):

Failed check: vbrief-ac

Acceptance criteria check FAILED — 2/55 AC incomplete:

### Live checkpoint: one gauntlet run across desktop, laptop and a Fly machine (2/3 incomplete)
  - [ ] Given a run with builders on the desktop and critics on a Fly machine and the laptop, when every lane has reported, then pan lane list --run <run> on the desktop lists every lane with MACHINE '-', 'fly-<id>' or the laptop label and a done report
  - [ ] Given the same run, when the Command Deck is opened in an isolated Playwright profile, then the screenshot shows both remote critics nested under the orchestrator conversation

## REQUIRED: Complete all acceptance criteria BEFORE resubmitting

1. Review the incomplete AC above
2. Implement the missing requirements and write tests
3. Close every completed task with `pan task close` — the canonical writer publishes the close and AC statuses sync automatically; never hand-edit spec files
4. Commit and push ALL changes
5. ONLY THEN resubmit: pan review request PAN-4638 -m "Completed acceptance criteria"

Do NOT resubmit until all AC are completed.
